Item.sqlserver_body: CREATE VIEW [Workflow_Task_Item_Type_Id] -- view returns the same as 'distinct SOURCE_TYPE from WORKFLOW' but with better performance with our expected data in WORKFLOW -- (order is not required now) AS WITH RecursiveCTE AS ( SELECT ID = MIN(T.SOURCE_TYPE) FROM innovator.WORKFLOW T UNION ALL SELECT R.SOURCE_TYPE FROM ( SELECT T.SOURCE_TYPE, rn = ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY T.SOURCE_TYPE) FROM innovator.WORKFLOW T JOIN RecursiveCTE R ON R.ID < T.SOURCE_TYPE ) R WHERE R.rn = 1 ) SELECT ID FROM RecursiveCTE
Item.name: Workflow_Task_Item_Type_Id
